answer: An attacker running 134 aliases thus needs 54 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in kernel, expire in nadir, and nectar lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2997 identities would post 2527 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
